title: Decrease Elements To Make Array Zigzag
description: Reduce elements to make array zigzag such that nums[i-1] > nums[i] < nums[i+1] or vice versa.

steps.note: Initialize result array to track moves for even and odd index peaks.
Processing index 0 (even). left is Infinity, right is 7.
nums[0] is 2, min(inf, 7) is 7. 2 < 7, no moves needed.
Processing index 1 (odd). left is 2, right is 10.
nums[1] is 7, min(2, 10) is 2. 7 >= 2, must decrease nums[1] to 1.
Processing index 2 (even). left is 1, right is Infinity.
nums[2] is 10, min(1, inf) is 1. 10 >= 1, must decrease nums[2] to 0.
